Dependable turn practice for tag checks
This section explains what applies on every shift

Companion Animal Travel Desk daily handling
This section keeps pet travel checks calm, fair, and clear so each traveler gets steady help from Aurelia Skyways. Staff should greet people promptly, listen for special handling needs, and keep carriers, tags, and papers in order before anyone moves toward boarding.

The welcome team should treat every pet as a shared responsibility, and every handoff should be spoken out loud in simple terms. When a traveler arrives, confirm the booking details, review the pet's condition, and guide the customer through any needed forms without rushing. If a pet seems stressed, pause the process, lower your voice, and give the traveler a clear next step. If there is a concern about fit, safety, or documentation, involve the senior coordinator right away instead of guessing.

<<FACT F021>> Staff should continue normal checks after the inserted line and keep the conversation focused on safe travel, clean records, and respectful service. Never promise boarding or lounge access before the required review is complete, and never leave a traveler uncertain about the next move.

All counts, limits, and acceptance decisions must stay accurate in the desk log and must match the guidance on the day. <<FACT F012>> If a request cannot be supported, explain the issue in plain words, offer the nearest workable option, and avoid blame or debate. Keep carriers secure, keep the area tidy, and return documents only after the final check is finished.

The desk should always protect the traveler's trust while also protecting the animal's comfort. If something feels unclear, stop and ask the senior coordinator or the duty lead for help before you continue. For any unresolved issue, contact the senior coordinator or the duty lead.
